title: Handyman Advertising: How a Handyman Business Can Get More Calls
html:
What are the best ways to advertise a handyman business?

The best ways to advertise a handyman business match how people shop for small jobs. They search for a specific task, such as a door repair, and they want someone who will actually show up. The table compares the main options.

Channel Best for Watch out for Where to start
Local search and Google profile People who search for a specific task Takes time to build List each service you offer
Google Ads Repairs people want done soon Mixed jobs bring low value calls Target the jobs you want most
Reviews and referrals Winning trust for work inside a home Needs a steady habit Ask after every finished job
Flyers and neighborhood groups Nearby homeowners Hard to measure Use a tracked phone number

How should a handyman use Google Ads?

A handyman should use Google Ads for specific jobs, not for the word handyman alone. Broad terms bring small tasks that do not pay for the drive, so choose the jobs that suit your rates.

  • Pick your best jobs: door and trim repair, drywall patching, fixture installs and similar tasks.
  • Set a minimum job size: say so in the ad and on the landing page.
  • Use call extensions: so a quote starts with one tap.
  • Track calls: so you know which ad produced a booked job.

A handyman ad earns its cost when it brings the jobs you want to do.

How can a handyman advertise on a small budget?

A handyman can advertise on a small budget by focusing on local search, reviews and word of mouth. These cost effort more than cash, and they build a base of repeat customers.

  • Finish your Google Business Profile and list every service.
  • Ask each customer for a review the day the work is done.
  • Leave a card or magnet with every customer.
  • Tell neighbors of a finished job what you can fix.

How do you decide where to spend first?

Decide where to spend first by testing three things: speed, fit and proof. A channel should bring calls soon, suit the jobs you want and show results you can measure.

  • Speed: how soon the channel can bring a call.
  • Fit: whether it reaches homeowners with the jobs you prefer.
  • Proof: whether you can see which calls and jobs it produced.

What mistakes should a handyman avoid in advertising?

The most common mistake is advertising every task you can do. A close second is not tracking calls, so nobody knows which ad worked.

  • Running ads for tasks too small to be worth the trip.
  • Running ads with no tracked phone number.
  • Sending every click to the home page.
  • Ignoring reviews while paying for clicks.
  • Judging a channel after a week instead of a full cycle.

What should a handyman measure?

A handyman should measure a few numbers each month. Those show whether advertising is paying for itself.

  • Calls and quote requests by channel.
  • Cost per quote request.
  • Share of quotes that become jobs.
  • Average job value by lead source.
  • Repeat customers and new reviews each month.

How does advertising fit with the rest of your marketing?

Advertising works best when your website and local profile are ready for the visit. A strong ad that lands on a weak page wastes the click.

Most handyman businesses pair ads with local search and a simple site with a quote form.

What is the best way to advertise a handyman business?

The best way is usually local search plus strong reviews, then Google Ads for the jobs you want most. People search for a specific task when they need it done, so being found for that task matters. Add flyers and referrals once the first channels work.

How much should a handyman spend on advertising?

Set a budget you can keep up for a full cycle, then adjust by cost per quote request. Start small, track calls and add budget only where it pays.

Does Google Ads work for handyman services?

It can, if you target specific jobs and say what your minimum job size is. Broad terms bring many tiny tasks that do not pay for the drive. Track calls and booked jobs, and judge the ads over a full cycle rather than a single week.

Are flyers good advertising for a handyman?

Flyers can work in a tight neighborhood, especially after a finished job nearby. They are hard to measure, so add a tracked phone number or a short web address. Keep the message simple: what you fix, where you work and how to call.
